description: Keep your list of the questions you asked the creator and are still waiting on. Free. action "ask": record every question you are about to ask (questions: a list of { question, topic, choices? }; topic is one of music, voice, sound, shape, picture, video, style, choice); then ask them all at once. While a question is open, the paid steps it depends on are refused (music for music, voices for voice, sound effects for sound, pictures, clips and renders for shape, picture and video, everything that makes something for style and choice). action "answer": when the creator answers, pass question_id and creator_words, copied from their own message; you can never answer for them, and a reply that answers only part leaves the rest open, so ask again in one line. action "list": what is still open.

action.description: ask, answer or list. Default list.

creator_words.description: For answer: the creator's own words that answer it, copied from their message.

project_id.description: For ask: the Editor project the questions are about, when there is one.

question_id.description: For answer: the id ask or list gave.

questions.description: For ask: the questions, each { question, topic, choices? }.

name: open_questions
title: Open Questions
